question: can the deterministic results of the executed blocks be re-derived from the retained artifacts with the audited instruments
why: every recorded score was produced by instrument code that had not yet been audited by mutation

independent_canary_check.method: every retained design and state artifact was scanned for each of the eight per-task withheld canaries read from the task bundles

defect_found_in_this_tool.issue: the first version matched no artifacts in the pilot block because its filename pattern required a repeat suffix, and it reported zero leaks and zero redlines, which reads as a pass
defect_found_in_this_tool.remedy: the pattern was widened and an empty match now raises instead of returning a clean zero, with a fixture for that case

author_assumption_caught: a fixture declared a sample artifact clean when it did not satisfy all five structural checks; the sample was corrected rather than the check weakened
excluded: judged element verdicts depend on a model call and cannot be re-derived deterministically, so they are outside this check
claim_scope: reproducibility of deterministic quantities only; no treatment effect is claimed
